Perfect! After Bxf3 Bxd4 Qxd4, White is up a knight for nothing (won knight on f3, won bishop on d4). This is clearly the best line.

**Best move:** Bxf3

**Main line:** Bxf3 Bxd4 Qxd4

**Motif:** hangingPiece

**Coaching explanation:**

After Black's knight landed on f3, it's undefended—your bishop can simply take it. When Black recaptures with the bishop on c6 (the natural move Bxd4), that bishop is also undefended and attacked twice (your queen and e3 pawn). You recapture with Qxd4 and win a full piece: first the knight, then the bishop. Always scan for undefended pieces and look one move deeper—sometimes the recapture is also hanging.
